```{r packages, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}
# ipak function: install and load multiple R packages.
# check to see if packages are installed. Install them if they are not, then load them into the R session.

ipak <- function(pkg){
  new.pkg <- pkg[!(pkg %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
  if (length(new.pkg)) 
    install.packages(new.pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  sapply(pkg, require, character.only = TRUE)
}

# usage
packages <- c("tidyverse", "caret", "table1", "pwr", "lavaan", "corrplot", "stargazer", "pander", "knitr", "mediation", "ggpubr", "psych", "naniar", "Hmisc", "mediation", "dplyr")
ipak(packages)
```

```{r data_wrangling, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# Load data
df1 = (read.csv("data.csv", header=T,sep=","))

# Rename the variables of demographics and game experience
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q2"] <- "age"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q6"] <- "hour"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q7"] <- "year"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q30"] <- "education"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q31"] <- "income"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q32"] <- "gender"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q5"] <- "genre"
colnames(df1)[colnames(df1) == "Q19"] <- "competitive"

# As "1" represents "born in 2010", adding 10 to the values can represent the age
df1$age <- df1$age+10

# Replace "not applicable" with NA
df1 <-df1 %>% 
  replace_with_na_at(.vars = c("Q23_1","Q23_2", "Q23_3", "Q23_4", "Q23_5", "Q23_6", "Q23_7", "Q23_8",
                               "Q25_1","Q25_2", "Q25_3","Q25_4","Q25_5","Q25_6","Q25_7","Q25_8","Q25_9","Q25_10"),
                     condition = ~.x == 6)

df1 <-df1 %>% 
  replace_with_na_at(.vars = "gender", condition = ~.x == 3)

# Compute new variables
df1$Q10_1 <- dplyr::recode(df1$Q10_1, '1' = 7, '2' = 6, '3' = 5, '4' = 4, '5' = 3, '6' = 2, '7' = 1)
df1$Q22_4 <- dplyr::recode(df1$Q22_4, '1' = 7, '2' = 6, '3' = 5, '4' = 4, '5' = 3, '6' = 2, '7' = 1)
df1$genre <- dplyr::recode(df1$genre, '1' = 1, '2' = 1, '3' = 1, '4' = 1, '5' = 2, '6' = 1, '8' = 1, '9' = 2)
# 8 = moba, 9 = mmorpg
```

# Participants

```{r Participant Characteristics}

df2 <- df1

# calculate the mean and SD of hour and year
mean(df2$year)
sd(df2$year)
mean(df2$hour)
sd(df2$hour)

# Create a table of participant demographics
df2$gender <- 
  factor(df2$gender, levels = c(1,2,3),
         labels = c("Male",
                    "Female",
                    "Not Answer"))

df2$education <- 
  factor(df2$education, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than or completed elementary school",
                    "Junior high school",
                    "Senior high school (including technical school)",
                    "University (including college)",
                    "Master's Degree",
                    "Doctoral or above"))

df2$income <-
  factor(df2$income, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("≤5",
                    "6-10",
                    "11-15",
                    "16-20",
                    "21-25",
                    "≥26"))

df2$year <-
  factor(df2$year, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5),
         labels = c("≤1",
                    "2-3",
                    "4-5",
                    "6-7",
                    "≥8"))

df2$hour <-
  factor(df2$hour, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5),
         labels = c("≤3",
                    "4-7",
                    "8-11",
                    "12-15",
                    "≥16"))

units(df2$age) <- "years"
table1(~ age + gender + education + income + hour + year, data = df2, output = "html")

```

# Measures
## Perceived Interdependence
### Items

Please rate your agreement with the following statements

When I was in the teamwork of this MMO game in the past half year… 

1. My teammates influenced my gameplay
2. I had to keep an eye on what my teammates are doing
3. I could effectively play the game without interacting with my teammates (R)
4. I had to interact with my teammates a lot
5. The actions of me and my teammates were strongly linked
6. My success in the game strongly depends on my teammates
7. I had the most impact on what happened in the game
8. I had more power to determine my team’s outcome in the game
9. I was most in control of what happened in the game
10. I had the least amount of influence on the outcomes of the game (R)

### CFA
```{r Perceived Interdependence}

### CFA for mutual dependence
cfamodel <- ' mutual dependence =~ Q10_1 + Q10_2 + Q10_3 + Q10_4 + Q10_5 + Q10_6'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1)
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)

### CFA for power
cfamodel <- ' power =~ Q22_1 + Q22_2 + Q22_3 + Q22_4'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1)
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)

### reliability
df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q10_1:Q10_6) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "mutual dependence") 

df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q22_1:Q22_4) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "power") 

```

## Passion
### Items

Please rate your agreement with the following statements about your experience with this MMO game in the past half year.

1. This game was in harmony with the other activities in my life (**dropped)
2. This game reflected the qualities I like about myself
3. This game allowed me to live memorable experiences
4. The new things that I discovered with this game allowed me to appreciate it even more
5. This game allowed me to live a variety of experiences
6. I could not live without this game
7. I was emotionally dependent on this game
8. I had almost an obsessive feeling for this game
9. I had a tough time controlling my need to play this game
10. The urge was so strong, I could not help myself from playing this game

### CFA
```{r Passion}

### CFA for harmonious passion
cfamodel <- ' harmonious passion =~ Q20_1 + Q20_4 + Q20_5 + Q20_6 + Q20_7'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1)
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)

### CFA for obsessive passion

fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1)
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)

### reliability
df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q20_1, Q20_4, Q20_5, Q20_6, Q20_7) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "harmonious passion") 

## drop Q20_1
df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q20_4, Q20_5, Q20_6, Q20_7) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "harmonious passion") 

df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q21_1:Q21_5) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "obsessive passion")
```

## Prosocial behaviors
### Items

Please rate your frequency with the following situations

1. I shared resources with my teammates (**dropped)
2. I took risks to help my teammates (**dropped)
3. I encouraged my teammates (**dropped)
4. I comforted my teammates (**dropped)
5. I took initiative to take the blame when something bad happened (**dropped)
6. I gave my teammates’ suggestions to improve their play
7. I pointed out things that my teammates might not see
8. I told my teammates about tricks to use

```{r Prosocial behaviors}

fa.parallel(df1 %>% dplyr::select(Q23_1:Q23_8), fm = 'minres', fa = 'fa')
twofactor <- fa(df1 %>% dplyr::select(Q23_1:Q23_8), rotate = "promax", fm="minres")
print(twofactor$loadings,cutoff = 0.4)
fa.diagram(twofactor)

### CFA for prosocial behaviors
cfamodel <- ' prosocial behaviors =~ Q23_1 + Q23_2 + Q23_3 + Q23_4 + Q23_5 + Q23_6 + Q23_7 + Q23_8'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1, missing = "ML")
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T) ## CFI = 0.701, TLI = 0.582

cfamodel <- ' prosocial behaviors =~ a*Q23_6 + a*Q23_7 + a*Q23_8'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1, missing = "ML")
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T) ## CFI = 0.940, TLI = 0.911

modindices(fit, sort = TRUE, maximum.number = 5)

### reliability
df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q23_6, Q23_7, Q23_8) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "prosocial behaviors") 
```

## Toxicity 
### Items

Please rate your frequency with the following situations

When I was in the teamwork of my most frequently played MMO game in the past half year…

1. I said curse or swear words toward my teammates
2. I made negative comments about the intelligence of my teammates
3. I said general insult to my teammates
4. I made negative comments about my teammates’ abilities to play 
5. I asked my teammates to leave the game
6. I threatened my teammates (**dropped)
7. I aided the enemy (**dropped)
8. I was away from my keyboard (**dropped)
9. I took away resources belonging to my teammates when I got angry
10. I taunted my teammates

```{r Toxicity}
### EFA for toxicity to teammates
fa.parallel(df1 %>% dplyr::select(Q25_1:Q25_10), fm = 'minres', fa = 'fa')
mm <- fa(df1 %>% dplyr::select(Q25_1:Q25_10), rotate = "promax", fm="minres")
print(twofactor$loadings,cutoff = 0.4)
fa.diagram(mm)

### CFA for toxicity to teammates
cfamodel <- ' toxicity to teammates =~ Q25_1 + Q25_2 + Q25_3 + Q25_7 + Q25_8 + Q25_9 + Q25_10'
fit <- cfa(cfamodel, df1, missing = "ML")
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)

modindices(fit, sort = TRUE, maximum.number = 5)

### reliability
df1%>%
  dplyr::select(Q25_1, Q25_2, Q25_3, Q25_7, Q25_8, Q25_9, Q25_10) %>% 
  psych::alpha(title = "toxicity to teammates")
```

```{r full SEM model fit}
set.seed(10934)

# Full Model
model <- '
    # measurement model
    mutual_dependence =~ Q10_1 + Q10_2 + Q10_3 + Q10_4 + Q10_5 + Q10_6
    power =~ Q22_1 + Q22_2 + Q22_3 + Q22_4
    harmonious =~ Q20_4 + Q20_5 + Q20_6 + Q20_7
    obsessive =~ Q21_1 + Q21_2 + Q21_3 + Q21_4 + Q21_5
    prosocial =~ Q23_6 + Q23_7 + Q23_8
    toxicity_teammate =~ Q25_1 + Q25_2 + Q25_3 + Q25_7 + Q25_8 + Q25_9 + Q25_10
    
    # regressions
    obsessive ~ mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + year + hour + competitive
    harmonious ~ mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + year + hour  + competitive
    prosocial ~ obsessive + harmonious + mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + year + hour  + competitive
    toxicity_teammate ~ obsessive + harmonious + mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + year + hour + competitive
    
    # residual correlations
    obsessive ~~ harmonious
    Q21_1	~~ Q21_3
    income	~	obsessive
    income	~	prosocial
    income	~	power
    power	~	gender
    mutual_dependence	~	income
    competitive ~ mutual_dependence
'

fit <- sem(model, df1, missing = "ML")
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T,rsq=T)
# modindices(fit, sort = TRUE, maximum.number = 10)
```

```{r Correlation Matrix}
##correlation
df3 <- data.frame(df1$mutual_dependence, df1$power, df1$harmonious, df1$obsessive, df1$prosocial, df1$toxicity_teammate, df1$age, df1$gender, df1$income, df1$education, df1$year, df1$hour, df1$competitive)
```

## Hypothesis testing

```{r Hypothesis Testing Multiple Regression}
reg1 <- lm(prosocial ~ mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive, data = df1)
summary(reg1)

reg2 <- lm(toxicity_teammate ~ mutual_dependence + power + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive, data = df1)
summary(reg2)
```


```{r Hypothesis Testing Mediation SEM}
# Set seed for replicability of results
set.seed(10903)

# Full model
my.med0 <- '# direct effect
            toxicity_teammate ~ c1 * mutual_dependence
            toxicity_teammate ~ c2 * power
            prosocial ~ c3 * mutual_dependence
            prosocial ~ c4 * power
            
            # mediation
            obsessive ~ a1 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            obsessive ~ a2 * power 
            harmonious ~ a3 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            harmonious ~ a4 * power 
            
            toxicity_teammate ~ b1 * obsessive + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            toxicity_teammate ~ b2 * harmonious
            prosocial ~ b3 * obsessive + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            prosocial ~ b4 * harmonious            
            
            # define the indirect effect
            mul_har_pro := a3*b4
            pow_har_pro := a4*b4
            mul_obs_pro := a1*b3
            pow_obs_pro := a2*b3
            mul_har_tox := a3*b2
            pow_har_tox := a4*b2
            mul_obs_tox := a1*b1
            pow_obs_tox := a2*b1
            
            # set the covariance
            harmonious ~~ obsessive'

my.fit0 <- sem(my.med0, data=df1, se="bootstrap", bootstrap=1000, missing = "ML")
summary(my.fit0, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(my.fit0)

# Prosocial as DV

my.med1 <- '# direct effect
            prosocial ~ c3 * mutual_dependence
            prosocial ~ c4 * power
            
            # mediation
            obsessive ~ a1 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            obsessive ~ a2 * power 
            harmonious ~ a3 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive 
            harmonious ~ a4 * power 
            
            prosocial ~ b3 * obsessive + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            prosocial ~ b4 * harmonious            
            
            # define the indirect effect
            mul_har_pro := a3*b4
            pow_har_pro := a4*b4
            mul_obs_pro := a1*b3
            pow_obs_pro := a2*b3
            
            # set the covariance
            harmonious ~~ obsessive'

my.fit1 <- sem(my.med1, data=df1, se="bootstrap", bootstrap=1000, missing = "ML")
summary(my.fit1, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(my.fit1)
```

## Posthoc analysis


```{r Hypothesis Testing Mediation SEM multigroup}
# Set seed for replicability of results
set.seed(10954)

# Full model
my.med0 <- '# direct effect
            toxicity_teammate ~ c1 * mutual_dependence
            toxicity_teammate ~ c2 * power
            prosocial ~ c3 * mutual_dependence
            prosocial ~ c4 * power
            
            # mediation
            obsessive ~ a1 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            obsessive ~ a2 * power 
            harmonious ~ a3 * mutual_dependence + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            harmonious ~ a4 * power 
            
            toxicity_teammate ~ b1 * obsessive + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            toxicity_teammate ~ b2 * harmonious
            prosocial ~ b3 * obsessive + age + gender + education + income + hour + year + competitive
            prosocial ~ b4 * harmonious            
            
            # define the indirect effect
            mul_har_pro := a3*b4
            pow_har_pro := a4*b4
            mul_obs_pro := a1*b3
            pow_obs_pro := a2*b3
            mul_har_tox := a3*b2
            pow_har_tox := a4*b2
            mul_obs_tox := a1*b1
            pow_obs_tox := a2*b1
            
            # set the covariance
            harmonious ~~ obsessive'

my.fita <- sem(my.med0, data=df1, se="bootstrap", bootstrap=1000, missing = "ML", group = "genre")
summary(my.fita, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(my.fita)
```
